Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 14 (Previously presented)

Claim 15 (Previously presented)

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body __and is electrically insulated from the sheathing body__.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising an inner layer and an outer insulating layer__.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube __having heating elements distributed along its length__.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube __and electrically insulated from the gas passage__.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection __that is separate from the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __in fluid communication with the flexible tube__.

Claim 22 (Previously presented)

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube __and configured to add moisture to the respiratory gas__.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __that provides structural support while maintaining flexibility__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __having a resistance value selected to provide controlled heating of the respiratory gas__.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the contact elements are positioned on an outer surface of the second portion__.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion __and is electrically conductive__.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __to accommodate the contact elements__.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion __and is electrically conductive__.
